title: Add a spouse as a dependent
description: A benefits administrator submits an 834 maintenance type ADD for a spouse on an active subscriber. The enrollment system stores the dependent and keeps the subscriber coverage unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an active subscriber, when an ADD is submitted with relationship SPOUSE, then the spouse is stored as a dependent.
The subscriber coverage effective date does not change.
The response outcome is ACCEPTED.

title: Add a child dependent under age 26
description: An 834 ADD names a child whose age is under 26. The child is stored with relationship CHILD and the same plan as the subscriber.
acceptanceCriteria: A child aged 0 through 25 is accepted as a dependent.
The relationship stored is CHILD.
The child coverage effective date matches the date on the enrollment.

title: Reject a child dependent aged 26 or older
description: An 834 ADD names a dependent with relationship CHILD and an age of 26 or more. The enrollment is rejected and no dependent is stored.
acceptanceCriteria: Age 26 or older with relationship CHILD is rejected.
No new member row is stored.
The rejection reason says the child exceeds the dependent age limit.

title: Terminate all coverage for a subscriber
description: An 834 maintenance type TERM ends the subscriber coverage and every active dependent on that contract as of the termination date.
acceptanceCriteria: The subscriber coverage end date is the termination date on the 834.
Every active dependent on the contract is ended on the same date.
The response outcome is ACCEPTED.

title: Terminate one dependent and keep the subscriber
description: An 834 TERM names a single dependent. The subscriber and any other dependents stay active.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the named dependent coverage is ended.
The subscriber coverage stays active.
Other dependents on the contract stay active.

title: Accept a retroactive effective date inside 30 days
description: An 834 ADD has an effective date up to 30 days before the file date. The enrollment is accepted and the earlier effective date is stored.
acceptanceCriteria: An effective date 1 to 30 days before the file date is accepted.
The stored effective date is the date from the 834, not the file date.
The response outcome is ACCEPTED.

title: Reject a retroactive effective date older than 30 days
description: An 834 ADD has an effective date more than 30 days before the file date. The enrollment is rejected and nothing is stored.
acceptanceCriteria: An effective date 31 or more days before the file date is rejected.
No member or coverage row is stored.
The rejection reason says the retroactive window was exceeded.

title: Reject an invalid relationship code
description: An 834 ADD uses a relationship code that is not SPOUSE or CHILD. The file is rejected.
acceptanceCriteria: A relationship other than SPOUSE or CHILD is rejected.
No dependent is stored.
The rejection reason names the relationship code.

title: Reject a second active subscriber with the same member identifier
description: An 834 ADD tries to create a subscriber whose member identifier is already active. The new enrollment is rejected and the existing subscriber is unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: A duplicate active member identifier is rejected.
The existing subscriber coverage is unchanged.
The rejection reason says the member identifier is already active.

title: Change the subscriber mailing address without changing the plan
description: An 834 maintenance type CHANGE updates the mailing address. Plan type, coverage dates, and dependents stay the same.
acceptanceCriteria: The mailing address is replaced with the address on the 834.
Plan type stays the same.
Coverage effective and end dates stay the same.

title: Change the plan from HMO to PPO mid-year
description: An 834 CHANGE moves an active subscriber from plan type HMO to PPO on a stated effective date. Dependents move with the subscriber.
acceptanceCriteria: The subscriber plan type becomes PPO on the effective date.
The previous HMO coverage ends the day before that date.
Active dependents move to PPO on the same date.

title: Apply maintenance type CHANGE to an existing enrollment
description: An 834 CHANGE for a known member updates the fields present on the file and leaves every omitted field as it was.
acceptanceCriteria: Fields present on the 834 are updated.
Fields omitted from the 834 keep their previous values.
An unknown member identifier is rejected.

title: Apply maintenance type TERM
description: An 834 TERM for a known member ends coverage on the termination date and does not delete the member history.
acceptanceCriteria: Coverage end date is the termination date.
The member record remains available for inquiry.
A TERM for an unknown member identifier is rejected.

title: Reject an 834 that is missing the member identifier
description: An 834 ADD has no member identifier reference. The file is rejected before any member is stored.
acceptanceCriteria: A missing member identifier is rejected.
No member row is stored.
The rejection reason says the member identifier is required.

title: Reject an 834 date that is not CCYYMMDD
description: An 834 date field uses a format other than CCYYMMDD. The file is rejected and nothing is stored.
acceptanceCriteria: A date that is not eight digits CCYYMMDD is rejected.
No member or coverage row is stored.
The rejection reason names the date field.

title: Make family enrollment easier
description: Families should have a smoother time when they enroll. Do the right thing for dependents.
acceptanceCriteria: It should work for families.

title: Handle coverage changes
description: When something about coverage changes, update the system.

title: Fix problems in the 834 file
description: Some 834 files are wrong. Handle the bad ones.
acceptanceCriteria: Bad files are handled.
